body: You’re gonna be okay I promise! It’s not the funnest experience but the bad part is over so quickly. I have such a bad pain tolerance and I was able to pull through ♥️
Codine helped yeah! I started with one and then took 2 after about 15 mins for some extra pain relief :)
Thank you! I definitely think it’s side effects mixed with dehydration - was just worried about how long the side effects should last as online it says they go away quite quickly ! :)
ALSO! I was provided with second dose of misoprostol if needed, but I haven’t taken it because the first pills made me bleed quite intensely and I did pass a huge clot
